messages:
maria.g: Quick summary from the GPTQ bake this week — ran GPTQ / AWQ / INT8 / FP8 on Llama2-13B, Mistral-7B-Instruct, and Qwen-14B. TL;DR: GPTQ gives best size/latency sweetspot for Llama; AWQ looks preferable for Mistral instruct workloads; Qwen showed KV-cache drift at long contexts with GPTQ (see notes).

ci-bot: benchmark job finished: job-20260318-42. Artifacts: gs://redwood-bakeoffs/2026-03/gptq_multifam_job-42.tar.gz

sasha: can you paste the key eval numbers (MMLU / Hella / Winograd-ish stuff)?

maria.g: sure, pasted the trimmed numbers below (baseline = FP16). These are micro-aggregates from our eval harness (100-shot-ish mixes).

# Aggregate (baseline -> quantized, delta)
Llama2-13B:
- MMLU: 63.4 -> GPTQ 62.9 (-0.5) | AWQ 63.0 (-0.4) | INT8 61.2 (-2.2) | FP8 62.8 (-0.6)
- HellaSwag: 85.1 -> GPTQ 84.7 (-0.4) | AWQ 84.9 (-0.2) | INT8 83.0 (-2.1)
- Code (HumanEval subset): 44.2 -> GPTQ 43.6 (-0.6) | AWQ 43.9 (-0.3) | INT8 40.1 (-4.1)

Mistral-7B-Instruct:
- MMLU: 56.2 -> GPTQ 55.8 (-0.4) | AWQ 56.0 (-0.2) | INT8 54.0 (-2.2)
- Instruction-fluency (qual): AWQ preserved instruction-following a bit better, fewer hallucination flags in our eval suite.

Qwen-14B:
- MMLU: 65.8 -> GPTQ 64.2 (-1.6) | AWQ 65.1 (-0.7) | INT8 61.9 (-3.9)
- Long-context QA (>8k tokens): GPTQ showed drift / KV cache mismatch on ~4% of queries (answers shift after token 4k). AWQ had fewer drift cases (~0.8%).

sasha: those Qwen deltas look concerning for GPTQ on long-context usage. Any idea why?

maria.g: hypothesis: GPTQ's per-group weight reconstruction + Qwen's custom KV layout interact badly at large sequence lengths — we see cache index misalignment in a handful of traces. Repro snippet attached from our debug run.

```
# reproducer (local debug)
./tools/gptq_quant --model qwen-14b --bits 4 --group 128 --calib 2048 --out /tmp/qwen-gptq4
python tests/long_context_kv_check.py --model /tmp/qwen-gptq4 --seq-len 8192 --seed 42
# observed: kv_index_mismatch in 43/1024 runs
```

lin: @maria.g did we check KV layout differences between transformer impls? might be an off-by-one in chunking somewhere.

maria.g: yes — we instrumented kv write offsets. It's not a simple off-by-one; looks like rounding effects when group-size != kv-block-size. AWQ uses a different packing that avoids that case.

devon: ops/infra sidenote — latency & mem numbers so we can pick rollout targets?

maria.g: benchmarked single-token generation (cold start) and steady-state throughput on a V100-class machine for parity:
- Llama2-13B: FP16 mem ~23GB, GPTQ-4 mem ~9.8GB, latency (P50) FP16 35ms -> GPTQ 48ms (+13ms), tokens/s FP16 120 -> GPTQ 95
- Mistral-7B: FP16 mem ~8.2GB, AWQ-4 mem ~3.6GB, latency P50 FP16 22ms -> AWQ 28ms, tokens/s 185 -> 150
- Qwen-14B: FP16 mem ~28GB, GPTQ-4 mem ~12.5GB, latency FP16 44ms -> GPTQ 63ms (KV-hit sequences much worse past 4k)

eva: Given these numbers, rollout suggestion?

devon: proposal:
- Llama2-13B: start GPTQ4 in Dedicated for low-cost non-sensitive flows; canary 5% traffic, monitor MMLU/LLAMA eval prompts and user-facing NPS for a week.
- Mistral-7B-Instruct: AWQ4 as default quant profile for hosted/shared infra — best accuracy/size trade and fewer instruction regressions.
- Qwen-14B: do NOT ship GPTQ4 to prod for long-context workloads. If we need quant for Qwen, prefer AWQ4 with extra KV-tests. Short-context Qwen GPTQ can be canaried at 1% with strict rollback rules.

lin: add automated KV regression checks in the rollout pipeline. If >0.5% drift on long-context probe set, auto-rollback.

sasha: can we get the raw CSV so SRE/product can simulate cost impact?

maria.g: uploaded artifacts + CSV: gs://redwood-bakeoffs/2026-03/gptq_multifam_job-42/results_summary.csv

ci-bot: perf-alert created: perf-alert-789 for job-20260318-42 (linked to ticket INFR-4321)

eva: I'll add the rollout checklist to the release doc. Items: unit eval prompts, KV liveness probe, canary percent, SLA rollback threshold, telemetry tags.

devon: one more operational note — for Dedicated instances we should add a per-model quant-profile flag so customers can pin e.g., "mistral:awq4" vs global "gptq4". avoids surprise regressions.

maria.g: agreed. I'll open a follow-up PR to model-configs repo.

sasha: thanks — can we sync 30m tomorrow to finalize the canary heuristics?

maria.g: yep — pinged calendar. Attachment: short runbook + raw logs in the artifact bundle. :white_check_mark:

ci-bot: created task TASK-2345: bakeoff followups (owner: maria.g, due: 2026-03-25)

sasha: nice, thanks everyone.

lin: noted — will add KV probes to eng-runtime tests.

maria.g: closing notes: main takeaway — GPTQ is solid for Llama cost reductions with small accuracy impact; AWQ currently a better general-purpose quant for Mistral and Qwen long-context resiliency. We'll keep exploring hybrid profiles (GPTQ for attention/linear separate quantization) next sprint.
